nodes.description: ERC20Interface.balanceOf(address who) external view function declared on the interface, invoked by BalanceReader on an arbitrary token address.
Address parameter 'who' of ERC20Interface.balanceOf; account whose token balance is queried.
BalanceReader.allBalances(address[] _tokens, address _who) public view function that loops over tokens and reads balances.
Array parameter '_tokens' holding the token contract addresses supplied by the caller.
Address parameter '_who' supplied by the caller, forwarded into each token's balanceOf call.
Local array 'balances' allocated with _tokens.length and filled with balanceOf results.
Loop counter 'i' used to index _tokens and balances.
External high-level call ERC20Interface(_tokens[i]).balanceOf(_who) executed on a caller-controlled address, which may run arbitrary code of the target contract.

edges.reason: Caller-supplied token address array _tokens is the input of allBalances.
Caller-supplied account _who is the input of allBalances.
allBalances allocates and writes the local array balances.
allBalances initializes and increments the loop counter i.
The element of _tokens controls the target address of the external balanceOf call.
_who is passed as the argument of the external balanceOf call.
The loop inside allBalances drives the repeated external call.
Loop counter i indexes _tokens[i] to determine the call target.
The external call dispatches to balanceOf on an arbitrary, caller-chosen contract, giving that contract control of execution.
The value returned by the external call is stored into balances[i].
The filled array balances is returned by allBalances.
